description:
Publish a video as a Reel.

Reels are the only way to publish video to the feed — Instagram converted standalone feed video to Reels. The video must be at a public HTTPS URL; Meta downloads and transcodes it, which takes time, so this tool waits for processing before publishing.

If processing outlasts wait_seconds the tool returns the container ID instead of failing; finish with instagram_get_container_status then instagram_publish_container.

Specs: MOV or MP4, 3s-15min, aspect ratio 0.01:1 to 10:1, up to 1GB.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

audio_name.description: Name for the audio track attributed to this reel

caption.description: Caption text, up to 2200 characters. Hashtags and @mentions work inside the caption. Instagram counts a maximum of 30 hashtags.

collaborators.description: Up to 3 public usernames invited as collaborators

cover_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a custom cover image. Overrides thumb_offset.

location_id.description: Facebook Page ID of a location to tag

share_to_feed.description: Whether the reel also appears in the main feed grid. Defaults to Instagram's setting.

thumb_offset.description: Milliseconds into the video to use as the thumbnail

user_tags.description: People to tag. Images need x and y coordinates; videos and reels take username only. The tagged account must be public.

username.description: Public username to tag, without the @

video_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of an MP4 or MOV video

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for video processing before giving up and returning the container ID. 0 publishes immediately (images only). Default 60.

name: instagram_publish_reel
title: Publish Reel
